About DingYao Advisory

Rooted in Taiwan, reaching into Cape Town — your trusted partner for cross-border property investment and lifestyle planning.

Our Values

DingYao Advisory bridges Taiwanese investors to Cape Town's property market with professional, transparent, and integrity-driven advisory services.

Integrity First

We only recommend properties we've personally inspected. No brokerage commissions, no conflicts of interest — your interests always come first.

Tailored Planning

From property strategy to retirement lifestyle, every client receives a dedicated consultant for a fully personalised plan.

Local Expertise

Our team is deeply rooted in Cape Town, working closely with top-tier lawyers, tax advisors, and property managers on the ground.

Data-Driven

Every recommendation is backed by official South African data and rigorous market research — so you can decide with confidence.
